def comps(g, color):
    seen=set(); res=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==color and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); comp=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            if dy==dx==0: continue
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==color and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                                seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
                res.append(comp)
    return res
